## Hello!

I am a Data Scientist and **applied researcher** with a **Ph.D. in Geospatial Analytics**. Over the past eight years, I have built predictive models to make sense of everything from telecommunication operations to ecological system responses. 

My passion lies in taking complex spatial-temporal data and turning it into clear, actionable insights. I enjoy blending foundational statistical methods, like **Bayesian inference** and **geostatistics**, with **modern AI tools** to build intelligent systems and novel frameworks that help answer tough questions. 

Right now, my interests are lie at the intersection of **Agentic Workflows** and **Complex Spatial Networks**. I am leveraging my background in computational statistics to explore how we can design AI systems capable of reasoning through and optimizing spatial data autonomously.

### Core Competencies
* **Modelling & Statistics:** Geostatistics, Bayesian Inference, Uplift Modeling, Survival Analysis, XGBoost, Generalized Additive Models (GAMs), Monte Carlo Simulation.
* **Programming & Data:** Python, R, SQL, SAS, Matlab, Amazon Redshift, PostgreSQL.
* **BI & Geospatial:** Tableau, Power BI, ArcGIS/QGIS, Alteryx.
* **AI Integration:** Prompt Engineering, GenAI integrations, Agentic Workflows (In Progress).


*This website is a portfolio of my experiments with agentic workflows and anything I find interesting in general.*

<div id="avatar-container" class="floating-avatar">
  <div id="avatar-sprite"></div>
</div>

<style>
.floating-avatar {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 30px;
  right: 30px;
  width: 240px; 
  height: 240px; 
  border-radius: 50%; /* Crops the square into a perfect circle */
  overflow: hidden;
  z-index: 9999;
  pointer-events: none; /* Lets you click on text/links behind the avatar */
}

#avatar-sprite {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background-image: url('assets/motion.webp');
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-position: 0px 0px; 
  
  /* THE MAGIC TRICK: This makes the white background transparent, 
     leaving ONLY your black wireframe and colored map visible! */
  mix-blend-mode: multiply; 
}
</style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const sprite = document.getElementById("avatar-sprite");
  
  const CELL_WIDTH = 240;
  const CELL_HEIGHT = 240;
  
  // ⚙️ UPDATED WITH YOUR EXACT JSON DATA
  const COLUMNS = 11;        
  const TOTAL_FRAMES = 121;   
  
  let ticking = false;

  window.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
    if (!ticking) {
      window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        const scrollPx = window.scrollY || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
        
        // The animation completes within the first 800 pixels of scrolling down.
        // If the 121 frames feel too fast, change 800 to 1000 or 1200!
        const SCROLL_THRESHOLD = 800; 
        let scrollPercent = Math.min(scrollPx / SCROLL_THRESHOLD, 1.0);

        // Map the scroll percentage to a specific frame
        let frameIndex = Math.floor(scrollPercent * (TOTAL_FRAMES - 1));
        
        // Compute the X and Y background-position for the CSS Sprite
        const col = frameIndex % COLUMNS;
        const row = Math.floor(frameIndex / COLUMNS);
        const posX = -(col * CELL_WIDTH);
        const posY = -(row * CELL_HEIGHT);
        
        // Render the exact frame
        sprite.style.backgroundPosition = `${posX}px ${posY}px`;
        
        ticking = false;
      });
      ticking = true;
    }
  });
});
</script>
